native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Host panel is the measurement. Tool JSON success is not FROZEN. Resume after the hold is not onset.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar
finshield.note: Panel stayed LIVE with advancing ticks 0 through 763. OpenProcess WinError 5 and NtSuspendProcess-never-reached text are not the desktop measurement.
